response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.av
